senses.en: a feeling that something is true or real

example.en: She has a strong belief in the value of education.
His beliefs guide how he treats other people.
example.zh: 他的信仰指导着他如何对待他人。

senses.en: an opinion or something you accept as true

example.en: It is my belief that the plan will work.
example.zh: 我认为这个计划会奏效。

senses.en: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk

example.en: A bird landed on the branch above us.
example.zh: 一只鸟落在我们上方的树枝上。

senses.en: a local office or division of a larger organization

example.en: The bank opened a new branch in the city.
example.zh: 这家银行在城里开设了一家新分行。

senses.en: to divide into two or more smaller parts or directions

example.en: The road branches near the river.
example.zh: 这条路在河边附近分岔。

senses.en: the thick fatty part of milk, often used in cooking or coffee
senses.zh: 奶油；乳脂（牛奶中富含脂肪的部分）

example.en: She added fresh cream to the soup.
example.zh: 她往汤里加了新鲜奶油。

senses.en: a thick soft substance put on the skin to protect or improve it

example.en: He uses a light cream on his hands.
example.zh: 他在手上涂一种清爽的护肤霜。

senses.en: to mix or beat food until it is smooth and soft
senses.zh: 把（黄油、糖等）搅打至柔滑

example.en: Cream the butter and sugar together first.
example.zh: 先把黄油和糖搅打均匀。

example.en: The bedroom walls are painted cream.
example.zh: 卧室的墙壁刷成了奶油色。

senses.en: later than a time or event
when a time or event has passed
